Customers connect their agents to Humanos during underwriting. From there, the same integration can support ongoing risk monitoring, prevention and renewal by keeping the agent's operational risk profile current. From underwriting to monitoring, renewal and claims evidence. 01 · The Challenge AI risk changes after the policy is written. AI agents can change how they behave, what they can do and the financial exposure they create over time. For InsureNow, underwriting them therefore requires more than a point-in-time questionnaire. It requires reliable answers to practical underwriting questions. Questions an underwriter needs answered 01 What can this agent do? 02 How much damage could it cause? 03 What safeguards are protecting it? 04 Is human approval required for sensitive actions? 05 Is its risk changing? 06 What actually happened if something goes wrong? InsureNow needed operational evidence it could rely on before cover and throughout the life of the policy. 02 · From AI Activity to Risk Intelligence From AI activity to operational risk signals. Humanos measures how AI agents operate and converts that activity into structured operational risk signals. InsureNow integrates those signals into its own proprietary risk scoring and underwriting framework alongside its other underwriting inputs. As part of the underwriting process, the customer connects its AI agent by installing the Humanos SDK in seconds. InsureNow does not need to build a new integration for every customer. The signals describe the factors that matter for an underwriting assessment: Customer Connects AI agent Humanos Operational risk signals InsureNow Proprietary risk scoring + underwriting assessment Exposure What the agent can do and the potential impact of its actions. Safeguards The limits, approvals and protections reducing that exposure. Behavior How the agent is actually operating and whether its behavior is changing. Changes Material changes that could increase or reduce the risk. Evidence Execution receipts recording what the agent was authorised to do and what it did. Data handling Customer data remains confidential and is handled in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including GDPR. InsureNow receives the operational risk signals needed for its underwriting assessment rather than a stream of raw customer data. 03 · One Integration Across the Policy Lifecycle One integration. Risk intelligence across the policy lifecycle. InsureNow is integrating with Humanos once so the same operational risk infrastructure can support its AI liability offering from underwriting through renewal and claims assessment. Underwrite. Humanos signals contribute to InsureNow's proprietary risk assessment before cover. Monitor. The agent's operational risk profile remains current as its behavior, safeguards and exposure evolve. Renew. Updated risk information can inform InsureNow's assessment at renewal. Claims evidence. Execution receipts and operational history can provide evidence to support claims assessment. Underwrite → Monitor → Renew → Claims evidence One Humanos integration · Across the policy lifecycle One integration for InsureNow Each insured customer Connects its AI agent through the Humanos SDK Humanos Provides operational risk signals and execution evidence InsureNow Applies its proprietary risk scoring and underwriting methodology 04 · A Risk Profile Refreshed Every 24 Hours The insured's risk profile is refreshed every 24 hours. AI risk is not static. An agent's behavior, capabilities, safeguards and exposure can change after a policy is written. Humanos refreshes the insured agent's operational risk profile every 24 hours, with more frequent updates available when required. InsureNow can integrate those updated signals into its ongoing risk assessment. The refreshed profile supports risk monitoring and prevention during the policy period and provides current information for renewal. It does not automatically change premium, limits or deductibles during the policy term. 24H Continuous risk monitoring Operational risk profile refreshed daily for monitoring, prevention and renewal. 05 · Same AI, Different Safeguards, Different Risk Same AI. Different safeguards. Different risk. Consider a claims settlement agent. An AI agent responsible for settling claims can represent very different levels of risk depending on how it is allowed to operate. An agent able to make higher-value financial decisions independently creates greater potential exposure. The same agent operating with financial limits and human approval for sensitive decisions creates a different risk profile. Humanos makes that difference measurable. InsureNow can incorporate those operational risk signals into its proprietary risk assessment. Example: the same claims settlement agent Greater freedom Stronger safeguards Makes higher-value financial decisions independently Financial limits in place Less human intervention Human approval for sensitive decisions Greater potential exposure Reduced potential exposure Same AI. Different safeguards. Different risk. 06 · Supporting Claims Assessment When something goes wrong, the evidence is already there. When an incident occurs, Humanos can provide evidence to support claims assessment: what the agent was authorised to do, which safeguards were in place, what action occurred and the sequence of events surrounding the loss. Humanos creates an execution receipt when an agent acts: a signed record of what the agent was authorised to do and what it actually did. These receipts create evidence that can help establish the sequence and triggering event behind a loss. This evidence can support InsureNow's assessment of what happened. Claims handling itself follows the arrangements agreed between InsureNow and its insurance partners. From reconstructing incidents after the fact → to having the evidence already there. 07 · Building Better Infrastructure for AI Liability Insurance Continuous evidence for a changing class of risk. InsureNow is building its AI liability offering around a proprietary underwriting methodology. Humanos adds a continuous operational view of how the AI agents being assessed actually operate. Through one integration, Humanos can provide operational risk signals during underwriting, keep the insured's risk profile current for monitoring and renewal, and provide execution evidence when an incident occurs. That gives InsureNow another source of evidence for assessing the AI risks it underwrites on behalf of its insurance partners. zh.summary: 把代理身份、授权与运行证据接成动态风险网络。
zh.judgment: 有价值的是执行前控制和执行后证据；风险分数对真实损失的预测仍待验证。
zh.replaces: 机构把代理权限、审批和日志分散管理，出问题后再拼操作过程。
zh.product: 官网提供运行风险评分、身份与授权控制、执行回执及风险情报。信用和保险是这些信号的应用方向，评分不是保险承保或赔付保证。
zh.customer: 代理开发者、受监管机构及风险评估方是明确对象。开发团队需要控制执行，风险业务需要解释证据，两者的用户、采购及合规责任不同。
zh.workflow: 在代理行动前核对身份、任务授权和限制，必要时捕获人工批准；行动后产生可验证回执与运行信号。应核验异常和授权撤销，不只看仪表盘中的分数。
zh.business_model: 价目将风险管理列为免费，风险情报 API 采用定制方案。商业化可能来自面向决策的持续信号服务；本次未确认 API 合同单价与收入。
zh.traction: 官网案例描述 InsureNow 使用运行信号支持承保及事件分析，属于公司案例。没有取得独立精算或损失对照，不能证明分数已改善保险业务结果。
zh.moat: 标准化授权证据与跨场景运行历史可能积累网络价值。日志平台、身份管理和代理治理工具也是替代；数据覆盖与可解释性比单一风险分数更重要。
zh.funding_read: 资金可支持跨机构连接，下一里程碑应是下游付费决策采用和可验证的风险解释。免费接入规模不能直接当作风险情报收入。
zh.risks: 信号缺失可能低估风险，错误授权或过度阻断可能损害业务。跨平台证明如果不一致，还会增加审查和争议成本。
zh.takeaway: 把权限、确认和操作回执作为默认执行链。让风险判断建立在可复核行为上，而不是在模型品牌或静态问卷上。
zh.watch_next: 看行动拦截与人工审批正确率、证据完整性、下游决策采用和付费合同。验证风险信号与实际事件的关系，保持预测和已发生事实的区别。

en.summary: A risk network joining agent identity, authorization and runtime evidence.
en.judgment: Pre-execution control and post-execution evidence are concrete; prediction of actual losses remains unverified.
en.replaces: Managing agent permissions, approvals and logs separately, then reconstructing incidents.
en.product: The site covers dynamic scores, authorization, execution receipts and risk intelligence. Credit and insurance are applications of signals; a score is not an underwriting or payout guarantee.
en.customer: Agent developers, regulated organizations and risk assessors have different needs. Execution control and business risk assessment involve distinct users, procurement and responsibilities.
en.workflow: The described chain checks identity, mandates and limits before action, captures approval where needed, then produces receipts and signals. Revocation and exceptions need testing beyond dashboard scores.
en.business_model: The reviewed page lists risk management as free and intelligence APIs as custom. Continuing decision signals are a commercialization hypothesis; contract prices and revenue were not established.
en.traction: An official InsureNow case describes signals used for underwriting and event analysis. No independent actuarial or loss comparison was retrieved, so improved insurance outcomes remain unproven.
en.moat: Standardized authorization evidence and cross-setting histories may create network value. Identity, logging and governance tools compete; coverage and explainability matter more than a single score.
en.funding_read: Capital supports connections while downstream paid decision use is a stronger milestone. Free integration counts do not establish intelligence revenue.
en.risks: Missing signals can understate risk and wrong authorization or excessive blocking can harm operations. Inconsistent proofs add review and dispute costs.
en.takeaway: Build permission, confirmation and execution receipts into the default chain. Ground risk decisions in reviewable behavior rather than model brands or static questionnaires.
en.watch_next: Watch control accuracy, approval accuracy, evidence completeness, downstream use and contracts. Test relationships with real incidents while distinguishing prediction from observed facts.
